title: 2.7 Pillars of Climate Resilient Green Economy of Ethiopia
description: Ethiopia’s CRGE strategy, its four pillars, renewable energy, forests and energy-efficient technology. Hard level.

questions.question: Why does limiting cultivated land expansion reduce emissions?
options: Rising at subduction zones and descending at ridges
Continents have moved into different climatic zones
Plates stick and then slip suddenly along fractures
It reduces forest clearing and soil-based emissions
questions.correctAnswer: It reduces forest clearing and soil-based emissions

questions.question: How do improved livestock practices yield combined benefits?
options: By lowering emissions of heat-trapping greenhouse gases
A programme of work on adaptation and response measures
It links crustal movement to the formation of landforms
They raise pastoralist incomes while limiting emissions
questions.correctAnswer: They raise pastoralist incomes while limiting emissions

questions.question: Why are forests described as providing ecosystem services?
options: Local variations can mislead; the global mean reveals the trend
They store carbon and support economic and ecological functions
They address different parts of the problem: causes and impacts
They extend beyond rising temperatures to ecosystems and storms
questions.correctAnswer: They store carbon and support economic and ecological functions

questions.question: Why are hydro, geothermal, solar and wind attractive for Ethiopia?
options: It cycles material between the crust, mantle, oceans and atmosphere
They deliver electricity at virtually zero greenhouse gas emissions
Growing forests absorb and store carbon dioxide from the atmosphere
It adjusts farming practice to cope with changed water availability
questions.correctAnswer: They deliver electricity at virtually zero greenhouse gas emissions

questions.question: How does energy efficiency in buildings fit CRGE?
options: Ocean and atmosphere circulation that redistributes energy
The bending of rock layers due to sideways earth movements
Adaptation that takes place before impacts become apparent
It reduces emissions through modern efficient technologies
questions.correctAnswer: It reduces emissions through modern efficient technologies

questions.question: How does CRGE support food security and climate goals together?
options: They are interdependent, so a change in one place leads to changes elsewhere
It raises farm productivity and income while cutting agricultural emissions
It is a market mechanism agreed in the Bonn Agreements to help meet targets
It was the negotiating body for the Framework Convention on Climate Change
questions.correctAnswer: It raises farm productivity and income while cutting agricultural emissions

questions.question: Why is leapfrogging used for the technology pillar?
options: Ethiopia can adopt modern efficient technologies directly instead of high-emission pathways
A vent is a pipe-like opening that builds a cone; a fissure is a narrow crack that builds a plateau
Mitigation reduces future warming while adaptation reduces current and near-term impacts
Natural causes can work through all three external mechanisms while humans mainly use two
questions.correctAnswer: Ethiopia can adopt modern efficient technologies directly instead of high-emission pathways

questions.question: How does reforestation contribute to carbon sequestration?
options: It cycles material between the crust, mantle, oceans and atmosphere
Growing forests absorb and store carbon dioxide from the atmosphere
They deliver electricity at virtually zero greenhouse gas emissions
It adjusts farming practice to cope with changed water availability
questions.correctAnswer: Growing forests absorb and store carbon dioxide from the atmosphere

questions.question: What development ambition is linked to the CRGE strategy?
options: It produces comprehensive assessment reports
Continental crust replaces the asthenosphere
The destruction of crust at subduction zones
Becoming a middle-income country before 2025

questions.question: How does exporting clean energy align with CRGE goals?
options: A comprehensive global framework convention to protect the atmosphere
Scientists doubted that so much drift could happen in so short a time
It generates income while promoting low-emission regional development
The lithosphere is divided into plates that move on the asthenosphere
questions.correctAnswer: It generates income while promoting low-emission regional development
